# Evernote.com

> The official Evernote website featuring AI-powered productivity tools and note-taking solutions

Evernote.com is the main website for Evernote, the popular note-taking and productivity platform. The site serves as both a marketing hub and a collection of AI-powered satellite applications that help users with various productivity tasks.

## Satellite Applications

The website features several standalone AI-powered tools called "satellites":

### [AI Transcribe](https://evernote.com/ai-transcribe)
The main transcription tool that converts audio, video, images, and online content to text. It includes these specialized features:

- [Audio to Text](https://evernote.com/ai-transcribe/audio-to-text): Record and transcribe audio files
- [Video to Text](https://evernote.com/ai-transcribe/video-to-text): Transcribe any video into text in seconds
- [Image to Text](https://evernote.com/ai-transcribe/image-to-text): Transcribe any image, PNG, JPG files into text
- [Link to Text](https://evernote.com/ai-transcribe/link-to-text): Transcribe online videos to text from URLs
- [Meeting Transcription](https://evernote.com/ai-transcribe/meeting): Meeting note taker - record and transcribe meetings in real-time

### [AI Recorder](https://evernote.com/ai-recorder)
The main browser-based recording tool with instant transcription. It includes these specialized feature:

- [Online Recorder](https://evernote.com/ai-recorder/online-recorder): Record voice effortlessly directly in your browser

### [AI Rewrite](https://evernote.com/ai-rewrite)
The main text editing tool that enhances and transforms content with AI. It includes these specialized features:

- [Summarize](https://evernote.com/ai-rewrite/summarize): Summarize text in different formats (paragraph, bullet points, meeting style)
- [Reword](https://evernote.com/ai-rewrite/reword): Reword text with different tones (friendly, formal, funny, concise, engaging, empathetic)
- [Humanize](https://evernote.com/ai-rewrite/reword/humanize): Humanize AI-generated or robotic text
- [Write Email](https://evernote.com/ai-rewrite/write-email): Draft professional emails from text input

### [AI Text-to-Voice](https://evernote.com/ai-text-to-voice)
The main text-to-speech tool that converts text into natural-sounding audio. It includes these specialized features:

- [Text to Voice](https://evernote.com/ai-text-to-voice/text-to-voice): Standard text-to-voice conversion with multiple voice options
- [Podcast](https://evernote.com/ai-text-to-voice/podcast): Transform text into engaging podcast recordings
- [Story](https://evernote.com/ai-text-to-voice/story): Turn text into compelling story narrations

### [AI Diagrams](https://evernote.com/ai-diagrams)
The main diagram creation tool that generates professional diagrams, flowcharts, and mindmaps from text descriptions

### [AI Detector](https://evernote.com/ai-detector)
The main AI detection tool that identifies AI-generated content in text

### [PDF Convert](https://evernote.com/pdf-convert)
The main document conversion tool that handles multiple file formats. It includes the following specialized features:

- [PDF to Image](https://evernote.com/pdf-convert/convert-pdf-to-image): Convert PDF files to images (PNG, JPG, WEBP, HEIC)
- [Image to PDF](https://evernote.com/pdf-convert/convert-image-to-pdf): Convert images to PDF format
- [PDF to Word](https://evernote.com/pdf-convert/convert-pdf-to-word): Convert PDF files to Word documents
- [Word to PDF](https://evernote.com/pdf-convert/convert-word-to-pdf): Convert Word documents to PDF format

### [PDF Editor](https://evernote.com/pdf-editor)
The main PDF editing tool for annotating and modifying PDF files directly in your browser

### [Online Notepad](https://evernote.com/online-notepad)
The main note-taking tool with rich text editing, AI features, and auto-save functionality

### [AI Meeting Note Taker](https://evernote.com/ai-note-taker)
Meeting note taker - record and transcribe meetings in real-time

### [Word Counter](https://evernote.com/word-counter)
The main text analysis tool that counts words, characters, sentences, paragraphs and provides reading time estimates. It supports audio, video, image and text files too.

### [Citation Generator](https://evernote.com/citation-generator)
The main citation generator tool for formatting citations of books or literature into your citation standard of choice

### [Note Taking](https://evernote.com/note-taking)
A landing page for Evernote's note-taking capabilities, showcasing how to capture ideas, organize thoughts, and boost productivity

### [Web Clipper](https://evernote.com/web-clipper)
A landing page for Evernote's Web Clipper browser extension, showcasing how to save articles, pages, and content from the web directly to Evernote

### [Documents Storage](https://evernote.com/documents-storage)
A landing page for Evernote's document storage capabilities, showcasing how to archive, backup, encrypt, and securely store documents, notes, and files

### [Templates Gallery](https://evernote.com/templates)
The main template collection for accessing professionally designed note templates. It includes these specialized categories:

- [Templates](https://evernote.com/templates): Main gallery with professionally designed templates
- Templates by category: Class Notes, Hiring & HR, Home & Living, Meetings, Personal Planning, Personal Well-being, Study Planning, Travel, Work Organization

### [Sitemap](https://evernote.com/sitemap)
The main navigation tool that provides a complete overview of all satellite applications

## Key Features

- **Multi-language Support**: Available in 8+ languages including English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, and Korean
- **Evernote Integration**: Seamlessly save results to your Evernote account
- **Free and Premium Options**: Basic functionality available for free, with premium features for paid users
- **No Account Required**: Most tools work without creating an Evernote account
- **Mobile-Friendly**: All tools are optimized for use on mobile devices
- **Secure Processing**: Files are processed securely with privacy protection

## Template Categories

The Templates Gallery includes professionally designed templates for:

- **School**: Class notes, study planners, assignment trackers
- **Work**: Meeting notes, project planning, hiring processes
- **Life**: Personal journals, travel planners, wellness trackers

## How It Works

1. Choose a satellite tool from the website
2. Upload your file or enter your text
3. The AI processes your content
4. Download or save results to Evernote
5. Optionally upgrade for premium features like larger file sizes and advanced AI capabilities

The website combines Evernote's note-taking expertise with modern AI capabilities to create a comprehensive productivity platform accessible through any web browser.
